## Barbell Bench Press - Spotting Technique

Stand erect and very close to the head of the bench (but do not distract the athlete)

- Place feet shoulder-width apart with knees slightly flexed
- Grasp the bar with a closed, alternated grip inside the athlete's grip (-3)
- Assist with moving the bar off the supports at athlete's signal (-3)
- Guide the bar to a position over the athlete's chest and release the bar smoothly (-4)
- Full attention should be given to the athlete through all repetitions of the set (-5)
- At the end of the set, the athlete will signal for assistance in racking the bar (-6)
- Keep a grip on the bar until it is racked (-6)
